count_semantics.items: Stack quantities at each persisted location; nested contents counted separately.
count_semantics.blocks: Actual palette index usage across every storage layer; unused palette entries are separate references.
count_semantics.serialized_items: Owned serialized contents; distinct from physical NBT stacks and metadata/journal references.
count_semantics.references: Encoded metadata, saved blueprints and recovery copies; not extra physical inventory.
count_semantics.actor_index: Every actor record scanned once; digp is an index, including duplicates and absent targets.

scope.meaning_of_complete: Every scanned target-bearing format was classified; unrelated world anomalies remain warnings. Not a migration or client acceptance.

validation.independent_source_review: passed after player carrier and unknown metadata-carrier fixes; final source hashes above

limits: Quantities describe saved records in this snapshot; visual copies, nested inventory, serialized contents and references are separate categories.
No identifier is authorized for retirement by this receipt alone.
Actor duplicate_records means extra n-1 records per group. Every member is scanned; any owned contribution or failed member makes a duplicate group incomplete.
Unclassified target-bearing structures and metadata-linked carriers fail completeness and add no active inventory.
Binding opens a temporary clone and may write housekeeping files. Arbitrary bit corruption detection is not fully proven.
No staging entry/restart, rendered behavior, migration, or human acceptance is claimed.
